title: The Nested Manifold of Human Reality
subtitle: Genetics · Epigenetics · Culture · Education · Social Context · Media

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “The Nested Manifold of Human Reality” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.explanation: From the folding of DNA to the global propagation of cultural narratives, every layer of human experience is cast under the same laws: minimizing variational free energy, maintaining a non-equilibrium steady state, and executing geometric curves across the manifold of reality. Genetics is the baseline metric tensor; epigenetics is environmental metric modulation; culture is a global coordinate system and attractor landscape; education is metric optimization and manifold expansion; social context is multi-agent coupling; media is exogenous state-estimation forcing. The complete hierarchy — genetics, epigenetics, physiology, individual mind, social context, culture and education, media and memetics, evolutionary trajectory — is bound by feedback loops across scales. Nature writes the code, experience edits it, culture runs the program, media broadcasts the signal, and awareness chooses the trajectory.
blocks.tts: The nested manifold of human reality: genetics as metric tensor, epigenetics as modulation, culture and education as coordinate systems, media as forcing — feedback across every scale.
